programmes.t: LIVE NEWS: FOX Local Los Angeles
programmes.d: Raw, real-time news from across LA. Watch breaking stories as they happen with unedited, deep-dive context.
Though an elderly patient believes the springs are helping him, Dr. Mike knows his improvements are psychological; Mike wants Sully to play Prince Charming.
Dr. Mike and her neighbors are up in arms when Dorothy becomes a best-selling author.
Loren proposes to Dorothy but has a stroke before she can answer; an old friend wants Sully to come to the gold fields.
Dorothy, Myra, and Grace go back to look for Mike; Preston plots to build a hotel-casino with help from his partner, Jake.
Monica must help a lawyer with an alleged heart condition and a quirky woman he inadvertently gave money to.

An accident occurs involving two women, Megan and Susana, who are dating the same man. The angels create a house on a deserted road, where the two friends, and Susana's husband, have Thanksgiving dinner.

The angels help with a social event for a well-known doctor, his wife, and his mother. A young child shows up at their home, claiming to be the child they agreed to sponsor. The wife welcomes the child, but the doctor and his mother are worried.
Monica and Tess take jobs as party coordinators in order to help an orphaned boy and a wealthy family discover what's been missing in all of their lives
Monica’s own faith is tested when she is assigned to live on the street to help a man who’s lost his wife, his home, and his self-esteem in a special one-hour episode

programmes.st: There But For The Grace Of God
programmes.d: Monica assumes the role of a freelance reporter to help a father realize the pressure he's putting on his son
Monica and Tess encounter racial violence, a neighbor who turns away from any involvement, and an angel with higher power that theirs, when they volunteer to help at an AIDS hospice
Monica steps in when a caustic female radio show host uses personal information about her daughter’s social life to boost her on-air ratings
In a battle to help save a shattered family, Monica comes face-to-face with a former angel who's now working for the other side
Monica reveals her true identity to convince a skeptical magazine editor, Callie Martin (guest star Dinah Manoff), that angels really exist
Monica goes to work as a television producer to help a driven young reporter after she leaves the scene of a hit-and-run accident
Monica puts on a police uniform to save a cop whose drug habit will soon destroy him
Dr. Mike worries that she cannot have a child, as Colorado Springs prepares for a Thanksgiving feast.

Newly arrived in Hong Kong, martial arts instructor Ip Man encounters stiff opposition when he begins teaching the Wing Chun fighting style. But instead of bowing to his rivals' demands, he perseveres and retaliates with amazing speed and power.

In this explosive third installment of the blockbuster martial arts series, when a band of brutal gangsters led by crooked property developer (Mike Tyson) make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.
Set during the Korean War, a band of prisoners at a POW camp find distraction from the hardships of war and a new sense of freedom in dancing.
From director Wong Kar Wai and starring Tony Leung and Ziyi Yang, THE GRANDMASTER is an epic action film inspired by the life of Ip Man, the legendary kung fu master who trained Bruce Lee.
In this rousing sequel to Kickboxer, Tong Po broods about his defeat at the hands of Kurt Sloan. Po and his managers resort to drastic measures to goad Kurt into the ring for a rematch.
David Sloan (Mitchell ) travels to Rio de Janeiro where the action is hotter, the women sexier, and the competition deadlier than ever before.

David Sloan is on a mission to free his wife who has been enslaved by an evil world champion, Tong Po. He attempts to gain entry into Po’s savage kingdom by fighting in the tournament of champions where the winner takes all.

A retired kickboxer goes on a mission to avenge the brutal death of his promising young student. Revenge is not easy, however, as the target of his wrath is a leader of an underworld kickboxing league.
A man seeks revenge against a brutal martial-arts fighter.
Salem is terrified to learn that the evil Toc-Toc is being released from suspended animation (a Netherworld corrections facility) for a crime Salem committed!

Sabrina and Maritza unsuccessfully try to convince Cassandra that littering isn’t cool. The trash in Greendale is so bad, that these “best friends for life” get their favorite skateboard star, Ricky Speed, to come and perform and clean up the pollution.
Sabrina is excited when Maritza asks her to go to the Plain Brain concert, but when her aunts invite her on a trip to the hyper spa at the same time as the concert.
Masamune goads the laid back Chaoxin into battle, but it backfires on him.
Masamune studies hard and manages to beat Chaoxin in the first battle of the Championships.
Tsubasa suffers a stunning defeat to the arrogant Chiyun.
A fierce battle takes place between Gingka and Dashan.

programmes.st: The Bey With a Hero’s Name
programmes.d: The team travels abroad and encounters Julian Konzern battling Desert Blaze single-handedly.
Gingka and the team meet the Russian players and battle them on the way to Russia, not knowing they make up the Russian team.

'No Pink is an Island': Captain Pink and the Aardvark are stranded on a desert island and captured by a horde of ants. 'Pinky and the Golden Fleece': Shepherd Pinky goes on a quest to retrieve Goldie, the king of Greece's stolen royal sheep.

'Home Stretch Pinky': Horse trainer Pinky tries to help Granny win the Kentucky Fedora - the world's famous horse race. 'Pink Pucks': To win a big hockey game, Pink conjures up Slusho to play goalie, only to have him lured away by an ice seductress.

'The Reluctant Ninja': To retrieve the stolen jade monkey for the Empress of China, the Panther enlists the help of martial arts master Ho Hum. 'Pantherella': The Panther reads the classic tale of Cinderella, but everything in the story's wrong!

programmes.st: Pink's Ark/Rain Or Snow Or Pink Of Night
programmes.d: 'Pink's Ark': Pinky vies with Manly Man for the last space on Noah's ark. 'Rain or Snow or Pink of Night': Mailman Pinky must prevent the insidious Dr. Jellyfingers from mailing a sticky bomb to the stadium to end football season once and for all.

Charlie and Itchy step in to break up an argument between two young puppies. Charlie and Itchy hope to help by telling them the story of how the leader of a street dog gang and a quiet unappreciated yard dog became friends.

Charlie wants to be seen as heroic so he can win a reward being offered by a local TV station. Charlie fakes several 'heroic saves' with Itchy, but they all seem to go awry. When he does save Itchy, the reward isn't what he expected.

Hoping to help Itchy conquer some of his fears, Charlie forces him to stay the night in an abandoned mansion. But Itchy discovers that he is not in fact, alone in the home. Two ghosts and a cranky cellar-dweller also are in the mansion.

Charlie is put on Heavenly Trial under the charge of misusing his Miracle Dog Tag. Itchy, coming to Charlie's defense, says Charlie used it selflessly to save a poor old dog, while Carface claims he was being selfish to get free snacks.

After returning from training in heaven, Charlie discovers that Carface has muscled Sasha out of her restaurant. Determined to get Sasha's place back, Charlie and Itchy decide to dress up as southern belles to captivate Carface into confession.
Scott, Stiles, and Boof head downtown to celebrate Scott's winning touchdown, and Grandma gives him a special potion that will keep him from turning into a werewolf for the night.

Grandma's long-time foe, Zazu, places a curse on the family, which turns anyone the Howards touch into a werewolf. Zazu agrees to lift the curse if Scott can give her an old photograph of her and his grandparents.

programmes.st: It's No Picnic Being Teen Wolf
programmes.d: Scott has to watch over Grandpa for the weekend while Grandma is out of town, but it's the same weekend as the school picnic.  Grandpa tags along with Scott and his friends, leaving Scott embarrassed.

programmes.st: Toot Toot, Tut Tut and All That Rot
programmes.d: The werewolf mascot costume is stolen by the uppity Upson High boys, right before the big game. Scott and Stiles must outsmart the snobbish Upson boys in order to retrieve the costume, or they'll have to find a new mascot entirely.
Sabrina is tired of the restrictions that come with being a kid. She casts a spell that catapults into adulthood.
Sabrina ends up in a new docu-series called, That Witch which becomes an overnight sensation! Sabrina soon tires of the demanding schedule and lack of privacy.
When Sabrina hears that her Grandparents are coming for visit she is excited. They have a important announcement to make.
Everyone is fed up with Sabrina and Gem's constant rivalry. Sabrina casts a spell to make Gem and herself closer. But she uses too much potion and it causes them to stick together.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Queen for a Day
programmes.d: Zane installs Sophie as head of staff at the café. Bella develops a sneezing allergy that also accidentally triggers her powers. Sophie seizes on the problem and looks to fire Bella and the band.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Jewel Thief
programmes.d: The girls discover the Mako crystals contain immense energy and need to mount a rescue mission when Zane jealously steals one in an effort to gain Rikki's attention.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Mako Masters
programmes.d: The girls sit their final school exams and have to avoid a water attack in public when the full moon rises early. They confront the water force in the Moon Pool and are given a message about Mako Island.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Beach Party
programmes.d: Bella's eager to ask Will to the end of year party until she sees him asking Rikki. A big misunderstanding occurs, which prompts Will to express his true feelings for Bella. Sophie tries to get Zane to change the name of the café.
Verne is picked on by Borge and Lucrezia when they see him playing a handheld video game.
A nervous Verne flunks his compulsory Scootsoomer driving test because he's afraid of heights. But he manages to conquer his fear at the Centre of the Earth on a wild ride.

When Verne's techno-magic almost screws up a mission to the Centre of the Earth, Verne is humiliated and leaves the school. But Zarlak seizes the opportunity. Working through a magic artifact in Verne's backpack, he gives Verne evil powers.

UBOS and the kids return from an action packed chase in Rootopia, Center-earth, to find the school under a sleeping spell. They've saved a magical Rupunzel Plant from Zarlak and replant it in the school garden. However, there are bigger problems afoot.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Too Close for Comfort
programmes.d: Don gets a second job at the Marine Park on the Pirate ship and outshines Cleo, threatening the future of her Dolphin show. Bella and Will find difficulty trying to connect with each others' interests.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: A Date With Destiny
programmes.d: Cleo discovers a comet is causing fish to flee the waters around Mako Island. The girls find a way to restart the message in the Moon Pool and discover the comet will collide with earth.
Much to his chagrin, Frasier becomes a local hero after he physically assaults a rude customer at Cafe Nervosa.
Frasier challenges his father to a game of chess, but when Martin wins, Frasier becomes obsessed with beating him.
Frasier and Niles square off in a court battle over the competency of an eccentric millionaire.
Frasier sets his sights on a female police officer who actually has a crush on his father.
The new station owner asks Frasier to help his fiancée stop smoking, but Frasier panics when he realizes his "patient" is his hard-driving agent.
Roz mistakenly thinks Frasier is in love with her when he tries to break up her new relationship.
When Frasier learns that one member of a focus group doesn't like his show, he stops at nothing to find out the reason.
Listening to a tape of his very first radio show sends Frasier on a somewhat uncomfortable trip down Memory Lane.
The Crane household is turned upside down when Daphne's old flame comes to town.
When Roz sets Frasier up on a blind date, Bulldog winds up falling for her instead.
When Frasier is awakened night after night by a recurring dream, he becomes obsessed with analyzing the psychological meaning behind it.
After Martin befriends a reclusive writer both Frasier and Niles admire, they become obsessed with reading the author's first manuscript in decades.
While filling in for Frasier, Niles gains fame after counseling a local basketball star who's in a slump.
After Daphne gets dumped by her boyfriend, Niles decides it's time to declare his love for her.
Frasier and Lilith join forces so that their son can gain admission to the most prestigious private school in Boston.

programmes.st: Our Father Whose Art Ain't Heaven
programmes.d: Martin buys Frasier an expensive painting -- but Frasier doesn't have the heart to tell his father that he hates it.

programmes.st: Dad Loves Sherry the Boys Just Whine
programmes.d: Frasier and Niles disapprove of Martin's relationship with his brassy new girlfriend.
Frasier finds himself in a precarious position when he tries to help the troubled marriage of a former high school acquaintance.
When Frasier becomes fed up with the rules and regulations governing his condominium complex, he decides to run for condo board president.
When Eddie shows signs of depression, a pet therapist thinks Martin's dog is simply reacting to the dysfunctional Crane family!
When the Crane brothers go away for the weekend with two attractive women, Niles discovers he hasn't quite cut his emotional ties to Maris.
Niles moves into a prestigious building and tries to impress his snobby neighbors with an elegant dinner party.

programmes.st: Roz's Krantz and Gouldenstein Are Dead
programmes.d: While volunteering at a retirement home, Roz becomes convinced that she's "the angel of death" after her first two patients die on her.
Rather than show his son that his dad's not perfect, Frasier agrees to join the station's softball team -- even though he has no idea how to play the game.

When Niles asks Frasier whether he and Maris belong together, Frasier goes out of his way to give his brother an honest, thoughtful response.
Frasier comes down with a case of the "bachelor blues" when he realizes that every single person he knows is dating someone -- except him.
Nobody believes Frasier when he claims to be dating a famous supermodel.

They were kid detectives. Now they're 18 and still solving child crimes. But when The Mystery Team is challenged to crack a murder case, they see an opportunity to finally prove themselves as real detectives once and for all.

After bailing Kevin out, Frank tries a new parenting tactic. Meanwhile, Maureen's shot at TV fame hits a snag, and Bill weighs a big decision.
As the Murphys and their neighbors scour the city, Bill bounces from one harrowing ordeal to the next. Rosie's debate turns into a rescue mission.

This week Greg Davis and assistant Alex Horne engage in some role-play to assess the success of a throwing task. Plus Noel Fielding has a sliding session, Swedishman Fred receives an intense video call and all hell breaks loose in The Battle of the Bath.

Melinda must go into the complex world of high school dating and gossip to find the reason behind hauntings at Ned's school.

Melinda lends a hand to Ned's girlfriend who thinks her deceased father is haunting her.
After the town experiences a series of break-ins, Melinda must face the town gossip blogger who knows and plans on sharing her secret.

Melinda helps professor Payne deal with an ex and her 10-year-old son, all while helping put to rest the jealous ghost of his dead wife.

When Melinda is given the file number of a murder case for which her father was lead prosecutor in 1979. With the file, Melinda sets out to find whether or not the victim's murder or the trial is linked to her father's disappearance.

Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), visits Woodstone Mansion and brings along an adoring male friend, inspiring Sam to spark a romance between them in the spirit of the holiday rom-coms she loves.

Sam and Thorfinn get caught in the crossfire as the scheme Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), and the ghosts have conjured up goes awry. Isaac's marriage to Beatrice sheds light on how apprehensive he has been in communicating his feelings to Nigel.

Sam and Jay are thrilled when they find a highly qualified assistant for the B&B; however, their new employee comes with some surprising baggage. Also, Thorfinn tries to help his son, Bjorn, deal with a bully.

Sam gives relationship advice to her and Jay's assistant, Freddie (Mike Lane), ignoring Hetty's warning not to get too close to "the help." Also, Sasappis strikes up a romance with Jessica (Nichole Sakura), the ghost who lives in Freddie's car.

Sam and Jay's assistant, Freddie (Mike Lane), purchases ghost-hunting equipment when suspicious activity leads him to theorize the B&B is haunted. Also, Sasappis risks losing his relationship with Jessica (Nichole Sakura) when Freddie sells his car.
Trevor receives disturbing news about his parents when they come to Woodstone B&B to collect his newly discovered remains. Also, Isaac and Nigel's relationship hits a roadblock.
Sam and Jay help Thorfinn create a perfect first date with Flower. Also, Hetty feels slighted by the ghosts' new housemate, Nigel.

Sam struggles to keep Isaac's spirits up after she hits a wall trying to publish a biography about him. Also, Trevor and Hetty conspire to keep their relationship hidden, and Thor tries to prove to Flower that he can control his anger.

Elias Woodstone returns to Woodstone seeking Hetty's forgiveness so he can stay out of hell for good. Also, Jay struggles to repeat an inspired culinary creation that he came up with after walking through Flower.

Alberta is thrilled when a living relative visits Woodstone to learn more about her, but things take a turn when she hits it off with Sam's podcast co-host. Also, Nigel uses his knowledge of Trevor and Hetty's secret tryst to try to blackmail Hetty.

After learning that Pete's daughter, Laura is getting married, Sam, at Pete's behest, tries to convince her to hold her wedding at Woodstone B&B. Also, Alberta and Isaac team up to solve the mystery of what happened to Crash's head.
When teen ghost Stephanie (Odessa A'zion), who lives in the attic, awakens to find her crush, Trevor, is now dating Hetty, she decides to sabotage all the relationships at Woodstone.

Sam, Jay and the ghosts go into detective mode when Sam's podcast editor gives her one last episode to wrap up Alberta's murder. Also, Trevor, Flower and Pete discover an email from a Nigerian prince asking for help.

When a woman shows up claiming to be the rightful heir to Woodstone Mansion, Sam and Jay enlist the help of a lawyer. Meanwhile, Isaac tries to decide how to spend half of Sam's advance on his autobiography.
Sam, Jay and the remaining ghosts unravel the mystery of which ghost passed into the afterlife. Also, Sam and Jay must relocate an owl to do construction on the barn to turn it into Jay's restaurant.
Sam learns that one of the ghosts' powers is to enter the dreams of the living and influence their decisions.

When Jay's sister, Bela (Puna Patel), and her boyfriend, Eric (Andrew Leeds), visit Woodstone Mansion, Eric reveals a major change that took place after his near-death experience there over Christmas.

Inspector Gadget's mission is to guard a priceless coin collection from the evil clutches of M.A.D.
Inspector Gadget protects armored cars full of money from the dangerous Dr. Claw.

To celebrate his birthday, Dr. Claw has Null and Void invent Kewpie doll bombs to explode on the moon and create the MAD logo.
Watch Inspector Gadget every weeknight at 7/6c on Pluto TV. Inspector Gadget foils M.A.D.'s plants to tap into Chief Quimby's crime wave computer.
Dr. Claw is causing dairy cows to stop giving milk. His diabolical plan is to monopolize the manufacture and sale of dairy products in Metro City.
Dr. Claw is kidnapping billionaires and stealing their money. Inspector Gadget rescues the captured billionaires and protects their money.
M.A.D. agents sabotage a U.S. space shuttle by planting a bomb on board.  Inspector Gadget foils M.A.D.'s plans and saves the space shuttle.
Millionaires in Paris are being robbed of their jewels and money.  M.A.D. is behind the plot; sending warning notes in advance.

When Quimby learns Thelma is being sent back to ancient Rome to learn the Secret of Roma inscribed on a mosaic at the Forum, he sends Gadget to stop her in the time machine. Gadget is also anxious to meet his ancient Roman relative, Gadgetorum.
Inspector Gadget battles in the deserts of Yetzanistand to stop M.A.D. agent, Fast Adbul, from stealing the sacred scimitar from Prince Abar.
Inspector Gadget foils Dr. Claw's plans to win a race where the prize money is a million dollars.
Inspector Gadget saves Professor Frafkin, the world's leading scientist, from being kidnapped by Dr. Claw.
The M.A.D. agents trying to destroy the circus are no match for Inspector Gadget, Penny and Chief Quimby.
Quimby informs Gadget that ghosts are in the homes of Metro City's most distinguished families and a MAD plot is suspected.
Dr. Focus of M.A.D. invents a machine called Sneezooka which creates the wind of 3 billion sneezes.  Inspector Gadget finds the secret laboratory and destroys the machine.
The world's most powerful microchip, the Pup1, has been stolen.  Dr. Claw and his Japanese counterpart, Iji WarudaSan, are suspects.
Inspector Gadget and Penny head off on a vacation in the country when they get a frantic call from the Chief that Dr. Claw has stolen an experimental missile.

The two budding chefs are placed in separate teams made up of contestants eliminated from the competition prior to the finale and must prepare one last dinner service for Chef Ramsay.
This season opens with twenty aspiring chefs presenting signature dishes in Las Vegas, where they split into two teams and attempt to impress Chef Ramsay.
In the second part of the season opener, the twenty contestants settle into their dorms and prepare their first dinner service, which goes poorly with incomplete and undercooked dishes being served.
The remaining contestants participate in a physical challenge. Each team has five minutes to climb a wall and retrieve as many lobsters as possible.
The two teams must create a healthy meal for Olympians Maurice Greene, Natalie Coughlin and Danell Leyva after a 3,000m run. The winners jet off to California's Temecula Valley Wine Country.
Chef Ramsay orders the remaining contestants to identify the particular protein used in five meat dishes. The fastest team to guess all five proteins wins a day at the beach in Malibu.
Dinner service comes to a halt when Jean-Philippe requests help in the dining room. When one contestant from each team helps the wait staff, Ramsay discovers that both draw illegible checks.
Chef Ramsay challenges the remaining contestants to create six stunning Chinese dishes, which will then be judged by the renowned chef Martin Yan.
For the team challenge, the remaining contestants visit an animal pen to choose a form of protein to cook with. During the dinner service, the budding chefs must impress Chef Ramsay's family as well.
The aspiring chefs must cut a steak, cook it to medium-rare and then serve it with a spice rub or sauce of their own making. The winners spend the afternoon lounging around a pool.
Hosting its first quinceañera, Hell's Kitchen throws a party fit for a princess. Each team must make a five course tasting menu based on the guest of honor's preferences.
Representatives from both teams have thirty seconds to gather as many slips of paper as they can while in a wind chamber. The teams must cook five dishes based on the ingredients listed on the slips.
Chef Ramsay asks the teams to create their own menus for a dinner service that features Ian Ziering ("Beverly Hills, 90210") and Nikki SooHoo ("The Lovely Bones") as special guests.
The teams must create an ethnic dish in 45 minutes including a protein of their choice. The winners go on a shopping spree at a boutique and receive a set of copper-clad cookware.
The remaining chefs participate in a challenge that tests their skills at identifying foods merely by touch. The winners eat seafood at Malibu's Nobu restaurant.
Chef Ramsay rewards the chef who has made the greatest stride in the competition with immunity from elimination during the next dinner service, in which the contestants try to impress the judges.
Chef Ramsay tests the remaining contestants' abilities to communicate with one another in a three-entrée relay race. The winners tour LA by helicopter and visit the King Gillette Ranch.

Ricky Ricardo paces the floor, awaiting word from Hollywood about his screen test. Lucy can't use the phone for fear the line will be busy when Ben Benjamin tries to call for Ricky.

Ricky and Fred are scheduled to judge a beauty contest but Lucy and Ethel plan for them to miss it. The four go out on a little cruise before the contest and Lucy has arranged for the boat's gas tank to be only half-filled.

For their trip out west, Ricky buys a new car to replace the old, beat-up one Fred bought. Lucy convinces her husband to teach her how to drive it. After one driving lesson, Ricky is a harried and beaten man.

The Ricardos and the Mertzes have a hard time finding accommodations that will please everyone on their trip to California. Ricky is driving and sacrifices his passengers' appetites for the sake of making mileage.

Ricky agrees reluctantly to host a new television show, sponsored by Phipps Department Store, and learns they'd like him to host with his wife Lucy. When Lucy finds out that Ricky didn't want her in the show, she sets out to sabotage the program.

Lucy is jealous when Ricky is asked to pose with five beautiful starlets for publicity photos and tries to get herself in on the action by inserting herself into every shot. Lucy is even more upset when Ricky goes to his first Hollywood premiere.

Lucy and Ethel are sick of their husbands dressing like slobs when they go out together in the evenings. After one particular outing, the girls get fed up and give their old clothes to a second-hand store.

Lucy's mother wants to join the Ricardos on their road trip out west. As anticipated, Ricky blows his stack when he hears that Lucy's mother wants to go along, and continues to complain that everyone's going on the trip.

Fred Mertz, managing Ricky's European band tour, is very concerned over the expense incurred when he misrouted Ricky's band so he books second-class train passage for the overnight trip to Florence and a fourth-class hotel for their stay.

On their return from Hollywood, Lucy has her hands full with Ricky when he is hailed as a major celebrity. The Ricardos' neighbors join for a grand homecoming celebration and block party in Ricky's honor when the Ricardos and Mertze return together.

After watching two women walk out of a local dress shop with $200 in purchases, Lucy and Ethel decide to buy the shop and go into business for themselves. The first signs of trouble begin when they can't agree on a name for their store.

Lucy decides to try a new look, despite her husband Ricky's objections. She borrows a black wig from her hairdresser Roberta, who tells Lucy it makes her look like a whole different person. With that in mind, Lucy decides to play a little trick on Ricky.

Lucy and Ricky are determined to get rid of the puppy their son has brought home. They have a hard time overcoming Little Ricky’s arguments that it’s a welcome addition to a home that already boasts a parakeet, a frog, a lizard, a turtle and a goldfish.

Ethel is jealous of Lucy's friendship with neighbor Betty Ramsey. Sensitive to this, Lucy decides that the three of them should have a nice lunch together. Although reticent at first, Ethel opens up to Betty upon hearing they are both from Albuquerque.

Ricky discovers a wad of cash in Lucy's purse and closet full of strange valuables and assumes they're all her ill-gotten gains. He doesn't realize Lucy has been legitimately collecting for her club's fundraising bazaar.
Lucy learns a movie star, Cornel Wilde, is staying in the penthouse directly above the Ricardos' apartment and sets out to catch a glimpse of the handsome actor.
Life magazine does a photo layout on the Ricardos and the only part of Lucy visible in the shot is her elbow. Lucy insists on getting a part in Ricky's act so that she can make a name for herself.
When Ricky leaves his clothes around the living room, Lucy gets angry and divides the room in half so Ricky can be as messy as he likes - on his side!

With her baby due any moment, Lucy finds it challenging trying to remain calm given Ricky's nervous behavior. When she asks the Mertzes to come over to offset Ricky, she winds up with three very anxious people.

Peggy, a teenage neighbor, breaks up with her boyfriend Arthur because she is infatuated with Ricky. Lucy tries to help the clumsy schoolboy learn how to dance in order to win back Peggy's affections. To complicate matters more, Arthur falls for Lucy.
Chip Jackson of MGM asks Ricky to perform at a party but he refuses in favor of a deep-sea fishing retreat. Lucy has a better idea - she tells Mr. Jackson that Ricky would be glad to appear.

Lucy arrives in Hollywood with Little Ricky to meet her husband and his new press agent, who intends on making Ricky the "Cuban Liberace." Charlie Pomerantz plans a publicity stunt he hopes will get Ricky into Hedda Hopper's gossip column.

Ricky cannot help Fred out by performing at his lodge show because he is already booked for a radio show that day. Lucy volunteers to help out so she and Fred whip up a Western act. Ricky discovers it's a rodeo show that he's booked for, not a radio show.
When Ricky cuts off Lucy's allowance and charge accounts because of her careless spending, Lucy finds herself short of funds. Ethel has tickets to a radio quiz show that has a cash prize of $1,000.

One of the girls in Ricky's show quits, creating a vacancy which Lucy wants to fill. She goes down for an audition and can have the part provided she loses twelve ponds in four days to fit into the previous singer's size 12 outfit.

Ricky is the emcee for a television variety show and Lucy wants to appear in one of its commercials. To prove to her husband that she has screen presence, she removes the inner parts of their TV set, gets into it, and does a commercial as he arrives home.

Lucy decides to take part in the fund-raising campaign of the Westport Historical Society and offers to get her husband and his band to perform for their kickoff function. There's only one hitch – Ricky refuses to do it.
Lucy, while souvenir collecting, lifted a cement block with John Wayne's footprints from Grauman's Chinese Theatre, and now a newspaper is reporting that she was seen and her arrest is imminent.

Little Ricky is scheduled to play the drums in his first music school recital. Although his parents and the Mertzes are overcome with nervousness, Little Ricky seems calm until his big moment arrives, then goes to pieces.

The town of Westport has commissioned a statue of a Minuteman to commemorate the Revolutionary War. The whole town is involved, from Fred who will serve as town crier to Ricky who will make the dedication speech.
Lucy plays the dominant parent role in their son's life. Realizing that he needs to spend more time with his son, Ricky agrees to spend his vacation at home to care for little Ricky.

Lucy dreams of a night in New York City after spending six whole weeks in their new Connecticut home and it turns into a nightmare. Carefully hoarded tickets to a Broadway musical are supposed to take the Ricardos and the Mertzes to see the sold-out show.

The Ricardos and the Mertzes are cast in Little Ricky's school play when it runs short of cast members. Ricky plays a hollow tree, Lucy is the wicked witch, Fred plays the friendly frog, and Ethel is transformed in to the fairy princess.

Kikyo paralyzes Kagome. Inuyasha appears before her. Kikyo has been gathering the souls of dead girls.

Sango fights Inuyasha, believing him to be her enemy. Naraku's plan is to have her fight to the death using the power of the Shikon Jewel shard.

programmes.st: The Secret of the Sacred Jewel Revealed!
programmes.d: Sango reveals the secret story of the Shikon Jewel's birth.

programmes.st: The Lake of the Evil Water God
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang meet Taromaru, the son of a village leader. They go to the Temple of the Water God, where children are being sacrificed.

programmes.st: The Stone Flower and Shippo’s First Love
programmes.d: In a certain village, Shippo meets a girl named Satsuki. Satsuki believes that her brother, who went to war, will come back.
Husbands are being lured away from their village by a beautiful demon. Their wives ask Miroku to defeat the demon.
Sango goes back to the slayer village in order to fix her Hiraikotsu, and Kagome goes back to the well so she can return to the present day.
Inuyasha is able to escape from the miniature garden with the help of Miroku and the others, and goes to save Kagome.
Sango returns to the demon slayer village and repairs her Hiraikotsu. She also lays her father and her comrades' ashes to rest.

programmes.st: The 50 Year-old Curse of the Dark Priestess
programmes.d: Naraku calls upon a priestess named Tsubaki. Fifty years ago, Tsubaki was defeated by Kikyo when she went after the Shikon Jewel.
Kagome desperately fights the curse placed on her by Tsubaki, a dark priestess. Meanwhile, Kikyo appears before Tsubaki.
Tsubaki's curse steals Kagome's consciousness. Kagome forgets feudal Japan in an illusory world.
Tsubaki visits the onmyoji mansion where she once trained.

programmes.st: Giant Ogre of the Forbidden Tower
programmes.d: Tsubaki is a priestess who was considered to be on par with Kikyo.
One night, someone possesses Sango to attack Miroku. The group examines the centipede demon that they suspect was behind it, but they are mistaken.
There is a rift in Naraku's barrier. But it's the beginning of the month, and when night falls, Inuyasha loses his demon powers.
Kagura approaches Sesshomaru and tells him to kill Naraku, but Sesshomaru refuses.
Shippo is sent a letter challenging him to a battle. The letter's sender is Soten Raijyu, and he is still just a child.
A demon born from a piece of flesh that Naraku discarded transforms into a man without a face and steals the handsome face of Muso, a traveling monk.
Muso attacks Kagome. Inuyasha destroys him with his Wind Scar. Naraku, who was watching the event, tells Kagura to tell Inuyasha where Muso went.
Muso regenerates even thought he was hit with the Wind Scar. Miroku tells Inuyasha that Muso has a heart in the area where he has a spider marking.
Inuyasha visits Totosai in search of a technique that can break through Naraku's barrier. There he meets Bunza, a wildcat-demon child.
Myoga comes to deliver a message from Totosai.

programmes.st: The Red Tetsusaiga Breaks the Barrier!
programmes.d: The Hyakki Bat demon Otakemaru tries to destroy the village along with Shiori's mother.

programmes.st: The Plot of the Panther Devas
programmes.d: The Panther Tribe attacks from the west.
Inuyasha slices through the Panthers' barrier with his red Tetsusaiga, and Inuyasha and Koga make their way into the castle town.

programmes.st: The Panther Tribe and the Two Swords of the Fang
programmes.d: The Panther King, the general of the Panther Tribe, begins to move with the power of the Shikon Jewel. Inuyasha and Sesshomaru attack the mummy.
Sango is asked to slay a demon by a young lord named Kuranosuke, who fell in love with her six years ago. Kuranosuke has looks, status, and wealth.
The Tetsusaiga is equipped with a technique that can break through barriers. Jaken plans to steal it from Inuyasha, but his plans continually fail.
Naraku tells Sesshomaru that he'll give Rin back if he kills Inuyasha, but Sesshomaru charges into Naraku's castle instead.
Naraku is trying to absorb Sesshomaru so that he can get the powers of a complete demon. But Inuyasha breaks through his barrier and interferes.
Kagome returns to the present day. She is busy preparing for a mock exam two days later.

Jane and Rafael are excited to find out the sex of the baby, but a medical issue means Jane might miss her graduation.  Xo notices that something is going on with her mother, Alba, but Alba is too embarrassed to talk about it.
Michael is convinced that Rafael is helping to hide his father and puts the thought into Jane's head as well, making her grow suspicious of Rafael's recent actions.
When Jane and Rafael receive news about their baby's health, they revisit moving in together which prompts a surprise from Rafael.

Jane is feeling distant from Rafael so she focuses on her writing instead, but is stuck with a case of writers block. When Jane runs into Michael he mentions a romance writing workshop, and she thinks she has found the solution.

When a crisis with the hotel overwhelms Rafael, Jane becomes concerned that he might not be as hands-on in fatherhood as she expected. Alba is having a difficult time with Xo's living situation which causes a strain between them.
Jane unintentionally ruins Rafael's chances of getting the hotel's liquor license back, but her attempt to help fix it means missing the Villanueva's Easter festivities.

Jane is desperate to fix things with Rafael and suggests working on a way to help them move past their problems.  Xo has been keeping a secret from Rogelio, but when she finally comes clean to him, Rogelio's reaction surprises her.

Jane is determined to do what's best for the baby, especially after she and Rafael learn that the baby is breech.  Xo (Andrea Navedo) continues to try to apologize to Rogelio, but faces an uphill battle.

Jane is nervous to attend her five year high school reunion because she feels her life is not what she expected it to be. Rafael confides in Petra about Jane's custody request, making Petra think she can fix the problem and become the hero.
After having false labor, Jane insists that Xo  and Rogelio go to Las Vegas to perform their show, but once they are gone the labor turns very real.
After Jane discovers Mateo's abduction, chaos ensues, especially when they all learn Sin Rostro is involved and demanding a ransom.
Jane is in a rhythm with Mateo, but finds herself out of step with Rafael and Michael and the potential love triangle brewing between them.
When a slot opens up in the graduate program that Jane has been waiting for, she is faced with her first big motherhood dilemma - leaving Mateo sooner than expected.
As Jane tries to juggle motherhood and school, she forgets to plan Lina's (guest star Diana Guerrero) surprise 25th birthday party leading to friction between the best friends.
Jane thinks she's ready to make a decision about her love life.  Alba has taken the proper steps to become a citizen, but Xo's past might make it more difficult than anyone was expecting.
Jane and Rafael begin estate planning for Mateo, but when Jane realizes that Mateo will inherit millions, she worries he will become spoiled. Jane is also finally starting graduate school.
Jane and Rafael interview potential babysitters, but Jane has specific and lengthy requirements. Jane attends her graduate school's Christmas party, but things don't go quite as planned.

When an introverted 17-year-old switches schools, the most popular girl mistakes him for a vampire. His supernatural persona helps him rule the school, but as word spreads, the truth becomes harder to hide!

In a world filled with Mad Scientists and Evil Inventions, one talented evil scientist's hunch-backed lab assistant has big dreams of becoming a Mad Scientist himself and winning the annual Evil Science Fair.

Melissa Joan Hart plays the not-so-normal new girl in town who discovers on her sixteenth birthday that she possesses magical powers. But Sabrina's biggest challenge isn't just fitting-in, it's surviving high school.
Tara Adams is just an ordinary high school junior, except for one little thing. Tara has a secret identity--she's Radio Rebel, the most popular radio DJ in Seattle.

When 17-year-old Sydney's divorced grandparents visit simultaneously, it seems there will be no end to the bickering. Then little brother's science experiment goes awry and instead of preserving roses, he sends both grandparents back to their youth.

In this cult classic, younger sister Hayley Wheaton (Danielle Harris) wishes to switch places with her popular older sister Alexia (Katherine Heigl) and the two bickering siblings awaken to find the wish has come true.

A wonderful, song-filled feature about an unlovable, murdered mutt (Burt Reynolds) who returns to Earth to do a good deed. He adopts an orphan girl who can communicate with animals and helps lead him to his killer.

Charlie and Itchy are back! Those lovable mutts from the treasured Family hit "All Dogs Go To Heaven" return for an all-new Animated Musical Adventure. Features the voices of Charlie Sheen, Dom DeLuise and Sheena Easton.
Three canines itch and scratch their way through everything and anything in an effort to save Christmas from an evil spirit (Carface) who wants to use dogs from all over the world to ruin Christmas.
When a take-charge alpha wolf and a laidback omega wolf get relocated halfway across the country, the two must set off on an incredible journey home in this CGI-animated adventure.
The Ninja must draw upon new powers to fight the Elemental Monsters and quell the Loyalist threat.

programmes.t: LEGO Ninjago: Dragons Rising: The Blood Moon
programmes.d: While protecting Ninjago City from daily threats, the Ninja encounters a new elemental master in league with an old enemy.

programmes.t: LEGO Ninjago: Dragons Rising: Shattered Dreams
programmes.d: Ras attacks the Cloud Kingdom to obtain information on the Forbidden Five; Euphrasia informs the ninja and they set off to save the kingdom.

The ninja try to flee from the rest of the Stone Army that has been brought to life by the Devourer’s toxic venom - and things get a lot worse when Garmadon arrives with a ‘Helmet of Darkness’ and seizes control of the Stone Army.

The Ninjas, Lloyd, Sensei Wu and Misako journey to the Dark Island to find a ‘Temple of Light’ that can restore the Ninjas’ elemental powers but are attacked by Starteeth (barnacle-like star fish) that start eating through their ship.

After battling off Garmadon’s Stone Army, the Ninjas finally arrive at the Temple of Light where they harness their pure elemental powers, concentrating them onto Lloyd who becomes more powerful than he ever imagined.

When the Ninjas’ attempt to return Garmadon’s ‘Helmet of Darkness’ to its perch at the Celestial Clock in order to prevent the final battle between Lloyd and his father from beginning fails, a Super Weapon is created that can destroy all of Ninjago.
When Garmadon uses his new Super-Weapon to turn Jamakai Village evil, he unwittingly unsettles the balance, allowing the spirit of the Overlord to cross over and possesses his body.

A great darkness has fallen upon Ninjago as Garmadon’s Super-Weapon has turned it evil but Lloyd and the Ninjas discover that light is more powerful than dark - and the final and ultimate battle is on.

After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd.

programmes.st: The Art of the Silent Fist
programmes.d: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord’s evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go.
Z-Blob returns in a daring rescue to break Mateo out of Dreamsmasher's "box" and helps him find Lunia's hourglass!
The Berlin Night Bureau receives a mysterious package with new 'goggles' to help them become more efficient dream chasers, but at what cost?
Mateo, Izzie, Zoey, and Cooper are unwilling participants in a sleep study at Happy App Headquarters, and it's up to the others to break them out!
The gang flees to the wilds of Central Park where they plan their next move against the Brain, and also receive an unexpected visitor.
When our heroes infiltrate the Happy App building to disrupt production they find themselves thrust into a robot fight club where they must compete!
Macy is mad! The three Harpies have kidnapped her mom, Queen Halbert. The NEXO KNIGHTS use everything in their power to rescue her.
The Cloud of Monstrox is growing more and more powerful with every Forbidden Power Jestro inserts. The capital of Knighton is under attack.
Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party.

Using his Stone to Life magic the Cloud of Monstrox turns Clay into a living, fighting, breathing stone fighting knight. But will Clay use his forces to fight for good or for evil? Does he have a choice?

programmes.st: The Good, The Bad and The Tightwad
programmes.d: Clay wakes up in the poor town of Nothing Hill which literally has nothing. Will Clay remember who he is?

The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd.

programmes.st: The Curse of the Golden Master
programmes.d: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas’ search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd.

Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive
Lloyd is free but Pythor and the Overlord are nowhere to be found. However the Ninja have a cryptic clue to their next plan - something called Codename: Arcturus. But what is it?

Back in Ninjago it is time for the final battle with the reborn, god-like Overlord. The stakes have never been greater and one ninja must make the ultimate sacrifice to try to stop his reign of destruction

After the battles in the Outlands, all is well in Chima. But in a deep, dark cave, ancient Tribes of fierce Hunters awaken after thousands of years of dreamless sleep. They march to the surface … their goal: To conquer all the Chi.

An arsonist is about to torch Matlock’s favorite men’s store and one of the owners will become Matlock’s next case after his partner is murdered.

Nora Dawson, a witness to a murder, is committed to an asylum and is being systematically driven out of her mind with drugs when the IMF team is given twenty-four hours to save her life.
Guest stars Gerald S. O'Loughlin and Christopher Stone portray crime syndicate bosses in charge of the waterfront who extort huge sums of money from every ship docking at a west coast port.
With Phelps and Rollin as the leading men, the Impossible Missions Force stages an anti-American play which could prove to be a strong propaganda device for the enemy.
An army commander (played by guest star Theodore Bikel) plots to become dictator by imprisoning an influential cardinal and using a look-alike actor for a public endorsement.
Guest star Bradford Dillman plays Edison, a former private detective turned extortionist who is blackmailing a powerful crime chief with a roll of film linking him to murder.
Cinnamon and Rollin become cabaret performers in a plot to get a deranged man (guest Fritz Weaver) to fall in love with Cinnamon, then kill her.
The IMF team goes in as a circus team to rescue Anton Cardinal Vossek, who is being held in the impregnable Seravno Prison.

When an unscrupulous manufacturer risks World War III by offering a hydrogen bomb for sale, the Impossible Missions Force enters the bidding with a dangerous plan to keep the weapon out of enemy hands.

Andrew Duggan guest stars as Justin Bainbridge, a multimillionaire paranoid militarist, whose son, Howard, defected behind the Iron Curtain with the formula to a lethal nerve gas he had developed in "A Ghost Story"
Miklos Klaar, an Iron Curtain filmmaker, has film of American soldiers and plans to edit it into an atrocity movie to discredit the U.S.

Stolen gems worth seventy-five million dollars scheduled to be fenced to an underworld figure suddenly disappear and the ship on which they were being transported is blown up at sea bringing the IMF team into the picture.
A grave threat to national security is posed when an enemy agent (Albert Paulsen) kidnaps two of the three key scientists who collectively know the formula for the cobalt bomb.

Guest star Steve Forrest plays the role of a millionaire publisher and communications tycoon who has sold fifty-one percent of his empire to an underworld crime syndicate which gives them a powerful influence over state politics.
Mister Rogers visits a film processing plant to learn how people turn an unexposed roll of film into finished photographs.
The Neighborhood of Make-Believe presents "Josephine the Short-Neck Giraffe," a musical story for children by Mister Rogers!

The special 3-part musical story for children continues as Josephine and Hazel Elephant enroll at the School for Growing, where they meet a snake who can't hiss, an elephant with stripes, and a very shy giraffe.
"Josephine the Short-Neck Giraffe" concludes today as shy J. R. Giraffe helps Josephine learn to accept herself just the way she is.
Mister Rogers helps out at Negri's Nusic Shop when Helena leaves to care for her sick son. Queen Sara learns that an employee of "Food for the World" is sick and her help is needed.
Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely show how they make an apple-peanut butter treat and remind children how much they learn from people other than their parents.
Mister Rogers shows a video about how people make peanut butter. Lady Aberlin agrees to take care of Daphne. Henrietta Pussycat suggests making a daycare center at the factory, and Corney agrees.

Mister Rogers meets Natasha, a famous oboeist. She shows pictures of her children and says she expresses her feelings for them through her music. Prince Tuesday is considering getting sick so that his parents will stay home from work.

Marilyn Barnett invites Mister Rogers outside for some exercises.  Bruce Franco carries a collection of balloon scuptures he has made for the party. He gives Mister Rogers a balloon sculpture that looks like the Neighborhood Trolley.

Mister Rogers introduces a week of programs about the environment. He shows how things can be reused. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, there's a real-life problem -- too much garbage -- and the neighbors are trying to find a solution.

Mister Rogers arrives with a bandage on his left hand. He pulls back the bandage to show that his hand is still there. Ana scraped her paw but does not want a bandage. Lady Aberlin is able to convince her otherwise.

Mister Rogers shows a film about how people make adhesive bandages. Prince Tuesday is looking for someone to play with but all of his friends are busy. At the suggestion of King Friday, he pretends that his rag doll has come to life.

Mister Rogers shows a video of wolves "singing," and wolf expert Kent Weber stops by with two wolves and explains that wolves are shy, not big and bad like in the fairy tales, and how they live together in families.
Folksinger Ella Jenkins visits Mister Rogers with her ukulele and shares songs her father enjoyed.
Yo-Yo Ma describes how he misses his family when he is gone and plays Bach's Sarabande on his cello. Sitting at the piano, Yo-Yo's son Nicholas plays the Skater's Waltz as a duet with his father.

Mister Rogers goes to Brockett's Bakery to decorate gingerbread men. After hearing the sound effect from the laughing box, Lady Aberlin sees how long neighbors take to laugh. Eric Kloss makes different sounds using a wind synthesizer.
Mister Rogers plays with different-sized cardboard tubes. Lady Aberlin is observing how neighbors react to the laughter box. Dr. Maggie Kimmel tells the story of “Button Broth.”

Mister Rogers shows a video of how people make toothbrushes. Lady Aberlin observes the neighbors' reactions after she can turn herself into a tiger. Princess Zelda arrives in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.

programmes.st: Learning to Take Care of Yourself
programmes.d: Mister Rogers brushes his teeth in his bathroom talks about how important it is to take care of our teeth, and even visits a dentist's office!

Mister Rogers shows a film of an earthmover digging a hole. Mr. McFeely shows a toothpaste video. Lady Aberlin wears a tiger suit, so she can be related to Daniel. Daniel declares that they are related by their hearts.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Has a Model Car
programmes.d: At the request of a television neighbor, Mister Rogers arrives with a model car and uses wooden blocks to build a roadway for it to travel. Prince Tuesday does not understand why he is not big like Neighbor Aber and King Friday.

programmes.st: Visit to a Conservatory for Plants
programmes.d: Mister Rogers plants a seed and visits a conservatory. King Friday orders Handyman Negri to sing a song about not being afraid. This makes the neighbors even more anxious about the “big thing” that is to arrive in the neighborhood.

Mister Rogers brings in a cat named Jimmy and remembers him as a kitten. He shows pictures of babies that have grown into adults. Everyone gathers at the castle just as the big thing rolls into the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.

programmes.st: Growing a Plant from a Seed
programmes.d: Mister Rogers says that the bean plant he planted a few days ago has grown. Robert Troll is the only one who can communicate with the “big thing.” He learns that it wants a blanket; the blanket causes it to sprout a stem and leaves.

Mister Rogers plays games that require patience.  Purple Panda experiments with a powder that causes flowers to grow. Prince Tuesday wishes the powder to make him grow. Mister Rogers goes to see the Harlem Spiritual Ensemble practice.
Harriett Cow shares the plans for a play. Lady Aberlin is greeted by a ballet dancer who dances her around the Neighborhood. The dancer inspires Ana Platypus to be a ballerina in the school play.

programmes.st: How Sweaters and Sneakers Are Made
programmes.d: Mister Rogers explains why he changes into a sweater and sneakers, and shows how people make sweaters and sneakers. Miss Paulificate brings Prince Tuesday's ragdoll to life by dancing with him. The neighbors decide their roles in a play.
Mister Rogers plays dress-up with wigs and glasses, and says: “You can get dressed up in the fanciest of things, but the best style comes from inside, and it often spreads on your face with a smile.”

King Friday suggests that the Neighborhood of Make-Believe be turned upside down to see if the missing crown might fall out. Trolley finds the spare crown! Mister Rogers visits the Boys Choir of Harlem.

programmes.st: A CLEAR-CLEAR HISTORY? SANJI'S STOLEN DREAM
programmes.d: Sanji takes a beating when his opponent suddenly turns invisible, Luffy finally manages to land a blow in his battle with Gecko Moria, and Usopp uses fire to ward off a zombie bear!

programmes.st: SAVE ME, HERO!! MY ENEMY IS THE IMMORTAL PRINCESS
programmes.d: After getting the stuffing beat out of him by a zombie teddy bear, Usopp summons his sharp-shooting alter ego to help him discover the secret to defeating Perona!

programmes.st: PERONA IS TERRIFIED!! USOPP AND UNTRUTHFUL SHARE THE SAME "U"
programmes.d: Usopp reaches deep into his devious bag of tricks to even the odds in his battle with Perona. Meanwhile, Luffy can't lay a finger on Gecko Moria, and a zombie is less than gentlemanly in his battle with Robin!

programmes.st: SLASHES DANCING ON THE ROOFTOP!! SHOWDOWN: ZORO VS. RYUMA
programmes.d: While Franky and Brook watch in awe, Zorro and the zombie samurai wage a sword-slinging battle the likes of which the world has never seen before!

programmes.st: CHOPPER IS FURIOUS!! HOGBACK'S EVIL MEDICAL PRACTICES
programmes.d: Chopper can no longer contain his fury over Dr. Hogback's evil treatment of his zombie slaves. Meanwhile, Luffy prepares to face the zombie who's wearing his shadow!

programmes.st: OARS ROARS! COME OUT, STRAW HAT CREW
programmes.d: Moria's mansion is reduced to ruins as the zombie with Luffy's shadow stalks the Straw Hats! As the walls come tumbling down, Chopper puts the hurt on Hogback, and Nami vanishes right before Sanji's eyes!

programmes.st: LUFFY IS THE ENEMY! THE ULTIMATE ZOMBIE VS. THE STRAW HAT CREW
programmes.d: One by one, the Straw Hats attack Oars, but the monstrous zombie appears too powerful to be defeated. Luffy's got his sights set on Moria, but he'd better hurry if he wants to save his crew!

programmes.st: YOU'RE GOING DOWN, ABSALOM!! NAMI'S LIGHTNING ATTACK OF FRIENDSHIP!!
programmes.d: Nami wakes up just in time to find out she's about to marry a zombie, but the special occasion is interrupted by very jealous warthog!

programmes.st: The Silver Fortress! Luffy and Barto's Great Adventure!
programmes.d: While heading to the next island, Zou, Luffy's appetite causes them trouble and he and Bartolomeo find themselves entangled in the scheme of a pirate lord who can manipulate silver.

programmes.st: An Underground Maze! Luffy vs. the Tram Human!
programmes.d: The Tram-Man arrives! And has Luffy, Bartolomeo and Desire on the run! The deeper the three fall into the pit, however, the more clear it becomes that Bill's group hides a terrible secret!

programmes.st: The Sword Technique Heats Up! Law and Zoro Finally Appear!
programmes.d: Luffy, Bartolomeo, and Desire make their way up the mineshaft, but Bill's assassin, Peseta, has other plans! Just when the going gets tough, help arrives, and Zoro battles the assassin head on!

programmes.st: A Desperate Situation! Luffy Fights a Battle in Extreme Heat!
programmes.d: Luffy, Desire, and Bartolomeo go up against Bill! But the mad, Smelt-Smelt man becomes deranged and lets his true power unfurl! Do Luffy and the others have any hope of exposing Bill's self-serving aims and turning his gang against him?

programmes.st: Curtain-up on a New Adventure! Arriving at the Phantom Island, Zou!
programmes.d: Bartolomeo recounts the formation of the Straw Hats, sharing their moving story with the rest of his crew! Meanwhile, the mysterious island of Zou approaches in the distance, obscured by fog. But when the haze clears, no one is expecting what they see!

programmes.st: The New Warlord! The Legendary Whitebeard's Son Appears!
programmes.d: Luffy and the others arrive at the mysterious land of Zou, and find the Sunny. But when they board, they find the other Straw Hats have already disembarked. Thus, Luffy, Zoro, Robin and the others take on the challenge of climbing the monstrous elephant!

programmes.st: A Deadly Elephant Climb! A Great Adventure on the Back of the Giant Elephant!
programmes.d: Finally scaling the elephant's back, the Straw Hats continue their search for the other half of their crew! But the mysterious "island" on the back of the elephant may hold more danger than they bargained for, as they learn they are not alone!

programmes.st: A Battle Begins! Luffy vs. the Mink Tribe!
programmes.d: Luffy pushes deeper into the mysterious forest on the elephant's back, but he's treading in territory where is not welcome! Meanwhile, Usopp and the others make a startling discovery in a ruined city!
Luffy and the others survive the Rain-Ruption and learn of its vital role in maintaining life on Zou.

programmes.st: Start to Counterattack! Great Moves by the Twirly Hat Crew!
programmes.d: Luffy and the others are unexpectedly welcomed at the fortress and treated well by the Minks, although they have to navigate some cultural differences… And Nami starts sharing what happened to them after they left Dressrosa.

programmes.st: A Threat Descends! The Beast Pirates, Jack!
programmes.d: Luffy and the others learn about the dangerous intruders who have come to Zou, and why the island is wrecked! Afterwards, Luffy's loose lips get them into trouble!

programmes.st: The King of the Day! Duke Dogstorm Appears!
programmes.d: Duke Dogstorm - the Straw Hats finally meet the ruler of this strange land, and learn more about the battle that took place here; and the mysterious system by which the island is ruled!

programmes.st: The King of the Night! Master Cat Viper Emerges!
programmes.d: Day turns to night as the Minks keep up their onslaught against the invading Beast Pirates! But Jack's amazing Devil Fruit power may end the elephant island once and for all!

programmes.st: The Exterminated Capital! The Twirly Hat Crew Arrive!
programmes.d: Night and day, Jack faces the fury of the two sworn defenders of Zou, but while they put up a good fight, the Minks aren't able to subdue Jack, especially after he brings out his secret weapon.

programmes.st: The Time Limit Closes in! The Bond Between the Mink Tribe and the Crew!
programmes.d: In the aftermath of Jack's deadly attack on the island of Zou, Chopper and Sanji rush in to save the fallen Mink Tribe - but they will need the help of Caesar to overcome the poisonous effects of the gas!

programmes.st: The Delinquent Comes Home! Emperor Big Mom's Assassins!
programmes.d: More of the dramatic happenings on Zou are revealed as we learn that Jack's pirate band were not the only visitors to the elephant island! And what about the mysterious fate of Sanji?

programmes.st: The Truth Behind the Disappearance! Sanji Gets a Startling Invitation!
programmes.d: The mystery of Sanji's disappearance deepens as Luffy learns that Big Mom's lackeys have caught up with him and the rest - and carry with them an invitation from Big Mom that simply can't be refused!

programmes.st: To My Buds! Sanji's Farewell Note!
programmes.d: Sanji's dire situation has become clear, but instead of rallying against Big Mom's crew, he submits to go along with them to bring an end to this situation. But being separated from one of his crew is more than Luffy is willing to tolerate!

programmes.st: Let's Go and Meet Master Cat Viper!
programmes.d: There's only one key to finding out what happened to Sanji - and Luffy and the others make their way towards finding out more about their friend's disappearance, but on their way the indigenous fauna give them trouble!

programmes.st: Luffy's Decision! Sanji on the Brink of Quitting!
programmes.d: Luffy hatches a plan to help Sanji, but he'll have to go alone to avoid an all-out war with Big Mom. Meanwhile, Kin'emon and Kanjuro finally arrive at Zou, unwittingly setting the stage for the Minks' thirst for revenge!

programmes.st: A Volatile Situation! The Dog and the Cat and the Samurai!
programmes.d: The samurai have landed! And they make their way into the country of Zou unaware of the welcome they will receive by the Minks!

programmes.st: The Third One! Raizo of the Mist, the Ninja, Appears!
programmes.d: Revelations abound as the true nature of the Wano clan and their relationship with the Minks is revealed! Momonosuke's role is greater than any had imagined! But even more shocking - the visage of Raizo the Ninja!

programmes.st: A Red Stone! A Guide to the One Piece!
programmes.d: The mysteries of ninjutsu enthrall the Straw Hats as Raizo, the implausible ninja, makes his true powers known! Meanwhile, a mysterious artifact points the way towards the end of the Grand Line!

programmes.st: The Secret of the Land of Wano! The Kozuki Family and the Ponegliffs!
programmes.d: The mystery of the Ponegliffs is revealed - their true significance, and the story of their creation, leads closer to the Straw Hats than they might have imagined!

programmes.st: A Vow Between Two Men! Luffy and Kozuki Momonosuke!
programmes.d: More mysteries of the Kozuki Clan are revealed - and the samurai propose an alliance to help topple Kaido! But Luffy's response will shock the crew... and force the young daimyo to take responsibility!

programmes.st: The Case of the Artful Dodger

programmes.st: The Case of the Lucky Legs
programmes.d: A worthless movie contract drives a glamour girl into hiding. Mason, asked to track her, finds more than he bargained for, including a love triangle and murder.

programmes.st: The Case of the Violent Village
programmes.d: When a young man just released from prison is accused of robbery and murder by the entire town, Mason changes his plans for a fishing holiday and takes charge of the case.

programmes.st: The Case of the Frantic Flyer
programmes.d: A widow concerned with reestablishing her dead husband's reputation with his wealthy father hires Perry Mason to defend her.

programmes.st: The Case of the Wayward Wife
programmes.d: In a labyrinthine search for the truth, Perry Mason goes from books to bookies.

programmes.st: The Case of the Prudent Prosecutor
programmes.d: The usual courtroom battle between Mason and DA Hamilton Burger is off when Burger has Mason disqualified because the defendant, Mason's client, is a good friend of his.

programmes.st: The Case of the Gallant Grafter
programmes.d: A bitter contest for control of millions of dollars is centered around the theft of $112,000 and an unscrupulous wife's revenge.

programmes.st: The Case of the Wary Wildcatter
programmes.d: Telescopic photographs of a man in the act of committing a murder become the principal evidence in Perry Mason's case.

programmes.st: The Case of the Mythical Monkeys
programmes.d: A mud-spattered, disheveled secretary telling a story involving a mysterious package, a ransacked apartment, an inquiring reporter, and a corpse, comes seeking Perry Mason's aid.

programmes.st: The Case of the Crying Cherub
programmes.d: Treacly paintings of infants and a Matisse masterpiece become equally important to Perry Mason.

programmes.st: The Case of the Nimble Nephew
programmes.d: Three hundred and nine acres of land, due to be worth five times their going price in a short time, become the test by which a man tries to determine the honesty of two nephews.

programmes.st: The Case of the Madcap Modiste
programmes.d: The queen of the fashion world is poisoned on the eve of an important spring showing.

programmes.st: The Case of the Slandered Submarine
programmes.d: Perry Mason refuses the check of a wealthy electronics manufacturer who wants to sue the US Navy and takes instead the defense of a sailor accused of murdering his captain.

programmes.st: The Case of the Ominous Outcast
programmes.d: A boy brought up in an orphange goes to a small town in California with hopes of finding his family but is accused of murder instead.

programmes.st: The Case of the Irate Inventor

programmes.st: The Case of the Flighty Father

Look out below when the Pawn Stars set their aim on a World War II era bomb-sight.
Roar down the road with the Pawn Stars as they stumble upon a Down and Dirty custom motorcycle frame.
The three couples that were married at first sight learn about the importance of trust in their relationships. Will their marriages flourish?
Steve and Antonio welcome a new member to their team, and when they decide to go after a food truck for Steve s wife, Steve is forced to confront his greatest fear.

programmes.t: Cajun Pawn Stars: Really Gotta Go Kart
programmes.d: The guys check out an old go-kart that, with the help of Yankee's restoration powers, has the potential to become something extraordinary.

programmes.t: Cajun Pawn Stars: Paintball Cajun Style
programmes.d: Two new items leave the guys star struck: A check signed by Judy Garland, and a 1932 World Series program for the game in which Babe Ruth famously "called" his home run.

programmes.t: Cajun Pawn Stars: Silver Dollar Spook-tacular
programmes.d: Jimmie challenges the staff to compete in a Halloween costume contest. Later, a customer brings in a 1967 Cadillac Fleetwood hearse.

Johnnie and Robby steer toward a deal when they look to invest in a dairy farm, while another customer attempts to unload a rare 1800s French gun. Later, the guys try to green-light the purchase of a classic 1990 Ferrari 348.

While cruising the back roads of North Carolina, the guys get a somewhat vague lead on the holy grail of motorbikes. The XAVW is a legendary masterpiece because of its detailing and unique components. Mike is determined to find it.
Tricky Dick's Tennessee yard is littered with treasures, and though he isn't motivated to part with any of it, Mike goes hog-wild for a vintage pig ride that could be worth some serious coin.
Mike and Frank head to Ohio and decide to make the trip a little more interesting by bringing along a cup dispenser from an old train station to trade with their clients, hoping to make some cash.
The guys meet a man who had pieces on display in the Smithsonian, but find that what he's held on to is even more mind-blowing. And a father/daughter power struggle is a roadblock to picking a farm.
To escape the BP oil spill, Tom moved his family and considerable collection to a motel in North Carolina.

Flying solo in Northern Iowa, Mike comes across the "Goat Man" and combs through his amazing, hidden-away property of junk-filled fields and buses. An Illinois couple's home proves to be a collector's paradise.

While picking in Missouri, the guys stop in at Sam and Stan's steelyard where the father-son duo takes them on a high-speed golf cart tour of their massive hangar and outbuildings, loaded with heaps of metal and rusty junk.
Make sweet music with the Pawn Stars as they check out a 1763 Stradivarius violin. Found in an attic, could this violin play a tune worth a million bucks or will this deal hit a sour note?

Contestants compete with throwing knives and slingshots. Before guns, these were the weapons that defined the skills of a true marksman. In addition to the elimination challenge, another contestant suddenly goes home.

The Pawn Stars have an opportunity to buy a 17th Century treasure chest that nobody can open--even though what's inside could make all the difference. Will they figure out how to get in and plunder what's inside, or will it remain locked?
The Pawn Stars are blown away when they meet a guy selling his homemade mortar that fires a very unique brand of ammunition--bowling balls.
The Pawn Stars set their sites on a sharpshooter's Kentucky Long Rifle from the Civil War.
The hunt is on when the Pawn Stars are presented with one of the most sought after items in American history, a John Wilkes Booth Wanted Poster.
Tammie and Johnnie try to lasso a deal on an antique toy horse, and a customer walks in with a very rare weapon.

programmes.t: Cajun Pawn Stars: The King and His Crown
programmes.d: The guys get all shook up when a seller drops in with a real-life piece of Elvis, and Jimmie sets his sights on a 1966 Cadillac Fleetwood limousine.
Johnnie and Tammy attempt to strike a deal on a 1971 Fender Precision Bass guitar that will leave Jimmie speechless.

programmes.t: Cajun Pawn Stars: Jimmie's Increasingly Bad Day
programmes.d: It's father vs. daughter when Tammie bets her dad that she can brighten his day and make a profit on a unique bar-on-wheels.
Jimmie challenges the team to get to work on time, and the last one to arrive has to take care of all four of the shop dogs for an entire day.
Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programmes.t: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi
programmes.d: From director Michael Bay, 13 HOURS is the gripping true story of six elite ex-military operators assigned to protect the CIA who fought back against overwhelming odds when terrorists attacked a U.S. diplomatic compound on September 11, 2012.
Action superstar Jean-Claude van Damme ("Bloodsport", "Cyborg") is a veteran undercover cop posing as an inmate in a dangerously corrupt state prison.
Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.
In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death”.
A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.
Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.
Michael accepts a sympathetic case for a Haitian man whose daughter was murdered by a corrupt government official, whom he believes is hiding in Miami.
A mysterious woman from Michael's past shows up at his loft with a plea: Help her retrieve her kidnapped son from a black market trader.
In the explosive season finale, Michael uncovers surprising facts about Victor's past and confronts Carla in a final showdown.
Arms trader Brennen (from Sins of Omission) returns and kidnaps Nate, forcing Michael to help him pull off an elaborate heist. Michael must also contend with Paxson's ongoing investigation.
Sydney is imprisoned and tortured at a secret detention facility.
The team devises a plan to frame The Covenant for Sydney's rescue.
Sydney tells Jack about a dream involving Will.
Sydney finally learns about her two years missing.
Sydney and Vaughn are both led, in chains, to a firing line.

When the Leverage crew tries to get a corrupt mixed-martial-arts promoter to invest everything he has in a fake cable television network, their con is discovered.  Now, Eliot must throw a fight to save the day.
The Leverage team takes over a hospital floor to stage the outbreak of a deadly virus.  They must quarantine a convicted felon and get him to reveal the location of his stolen money… or die.
While trying to recover embezzled cash from a Madoff-like fund manager, the team finds themselves acting as unlikely fairy godparents to the mark's lovable-loser stepson.

programmes.st: The Three Days of the Hunter Job
programmes.d: The crew dives into the paranoid world of government conspiracies to expose a heartless tabloid newscaster as a fraud.
Nate and the team put on a magic show to infiltrate a high-security corporation responsible for putting tainted food on the market.
The Leverage team is forced to go head-to-head with another crew of thieves to retrieve their clients' priceless artwork.
With Sophie away, Hardison plays the inside man to take down an unscrupulous diamond merchant.  When he overdoes it, the team is forced to break into Boston's most secure vault.
The Leverage team tries to stop a corrupt lawyer from taking control of his wealthy client's estate by convincing him that Parker is the man's long-lost daughter.
In the aftermath of Oliver's fight with Ra's al Ghul, Diggle & Arsenal continue to protect the city in the Arrow's absence. But the team begins to fear the worst for their friend
Arsenal & Diggle confront Laurel about fighting crime, warning her to stop before she gets herself killed. But, when Brick (Vinnie Jones) attacks the city, it's all suits on deck.
Still operating without Oliver and desperate to stop Brick, Team Arrow considers an offer by Malcolm to help shut Brick down—as Merlyn has a score to settle with the felon.
Oliver is thrown by the changes within Team Arrow. And Vertigo (guest star Peter Stormare) returns and pits Canary against Black Canary.
A grisly murder stokes the class division of Snowpiercer; Melanie deputizes a dangerous rebel to help solve the killing - Andre Layton, the world's only surviving homicide detective.

Layton uses his new position as train detective to investigate the murder while gathering intel for the revolution on the side; Melanie faces a resource crisis, with potentially drastic consequences for the entire train.

Layton descends into Snowpiercer's black market with Till, searching for both the killer and a valuable commodity for his revolution; Melanie stages a prize fight to distract the passengers from mounting class tension.

A shocking twist in the murder investigation brings Layton and Till's manhunt to a cat-and-mouse climax, but Layton is getting too close to Melanie's big secret, which may prove the most dangerous game of all.

The team has scattered, all living the ideal versions of their lives. Soon these "strangers" are drawn together to solve a supernatural mystery – the appearance of Ariel, the sprite bound to Prospero's service.
The Librarians discover that Prospero's renewed magic is wreaking havoc with the technology of the world. He is recreating an idyllic forest utopia.
When the Egyptian God of Chaos inhabits a human body, he attempts to release Pure Evil into the world, thus beginning the final battle of Good vs. Evil.

Flynn leads his fellow Librarians on a mission to rescue kidnapped Charlene, unwittingly ensnaring them in a subterranean trap filled with ancient Egyptian werewolves, led by nemesis Apep, who are determined to kill the Librarians once and for all.
After discovering that Jasper may still be alive, Clarke, Bellamy, Octavia, Finn and Monty set out to locate him and are shocked at what they find.
Clarke, Finn and Wells set out in search of an antibiotic to treat Jasper's wounds, when an acid fog forces them to seek shelter...and forgiveness for past crimes.
Abby risks having herself floated in order to give Raven (recurring guest star LINDSEY MORGAN) the chance to stow-away in the escape pod bound for Earth.
After exposing Kane's plan to reduce the population of the Ark, Abby and  Chancellor Jaha notice a signal from Earth and realize at least some of the 100 must still be alive.
While Bellamy leads his crew into Grounder territory in a search for Olivia, Raven can't help but notice the deep connection between Finn and Clarke.
